description_en: Creates a gateway quota throttling rule
description_zh: 新增网关配额限流规则
name: AddGatewayQuotaRule

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The conflict snapshot hash used to prevent concurrent dirty overwrites during confirmation. Obtain this value from the response of a previous dry run (dryRun=true).

This parameter is not required in the following cases: no conflicts exist, the request is a dry run (dryRun=true), or overwrite is set to false.

When dryRun is set to false and overwrite is set to true, if this parameter is not provided or the value has expired and no longer matches, the backend returns accepted=false with a new conflict preview. In this case, perform a new dry run to confirm the latest conflicts
parameters.help_zh:
冲突快照哈希，用于“确认覆盖时防并发脏覆盖”。通过先执行dryRun=true在返回数据提取。

当以下情况不需要填写：没有冲突；只是dryRun=true预检；overwrite=false，即不确认覆盖。

当当dryRun = false且overwrite=true时不带改参数或者该参数过期不匹配，后端会返回：accepted=false并带新的冲突预览，需要重新执行dryrun确认新的冲突
parameters.name: conflict_hash

parameters.help_en: The list of API consumer group IDs to bind to the rule. This parameter is used when subjectType is set to consumer_group and cannot be specified together with consumerIds
parameters.help_zh: 绑定规则的消费者组ID列表
parameters.name: consumer_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of API consumer IDs to bind to the rule. A maximum of 1,000 consumers can be specified in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 绑定规则的消费者ID列表。单次最多可操作 1000 个消费者
parameters.name: consumer_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run without persisting or applying the configuration. A dry run checks whether conflicting rules exist on the bound consumer subjects. For example, a consumer subject that already has a calendar-day quota rule cannot have another calendar-day quota rule added
parameters.help_zh: 是否仅预检（预检不下发实际配置），用于检查绑定的消费主体上是否存在冲突的规则（同一消费主体不能配置两个相同周期的自然周期配额，例如已有自然日配额的消费主体不能再新增一个自然日配额规则）
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow overwriting when conflicts exist. If overwriting is allowed, the conflicting subjects (consumers or consumer groups) are unbound from the old rule and bound to the new rule
parameters.help_zh: 冲突时是否允许覆盖。注意如果选择允许覆盖，冲突主体（消费者或消费者组）会从旧规则解绑并绑定到新规则
parameters.name: overwrite

parameters.help_en: The period multiplier, which specifies the number of periods after which the quota resets. This parameter is required for custom (epoch) period rules. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 60
parameters.help_zh: 周期倍数。该参数针对自定义周期规则
parameters.name: period_multiplier

parameters.help_en: The period type. For calendar periods, the quota can be calculated by day, week, or month. Valid values: day, week, and month. For custom (epoch) periods, only day is supported
parameters.help_zh: 周期类型。自然周期支持按日、周、月统计，取值为 day、week 或 month；自定义周期仅支持按日统计，固定取值为 day
parameters.name: period_type

parameters.help_en: The quota dimension or throttling type. Valid values: token and credit
parameters.help_zh: 配额维度/限制类型，目前支持token、credit
parameters.name: quota_dimension

parameters.help_en: The total available quota per period
parameters.name: quota_limit

parameters.help_en:
The type of the rule subject. Valid values:
consumer: API consumer.
consumer_group: API consumer group.

Default value: consumer
parameters.help_zh: 规则主体类型。consumer代表消费者；consumer_group代表消费者组。不传时默认为consumer
parameters.name: subject_type

parameters.help_en: The time zone for calendar periods, in UTC+x format
parameters.help_zh: 自然周期对应的时区(UTC+x格式)
parameters.name: timezone

parameters.help_en:
The reset period alignment type. Valid values:
calendar: The quota resets at the beginning of a calendar day, week, or month.
epoch: The quota resets based on a custom period that starts when the rule takes effect
parameters.help_zh: 重置周期类型。支持自然周期（windowAlignment=calendar）和自定义周期（windowAlignment=epoch）
parameters.name: window_alignment

code.description_en: The status code or error code

accepted.description_en: Indicates whether the write request is accepted by the system. A value of false typically indicates a retryable scenario, such as an unconfirmed conflict overwrite
accepted.description_zh: 本次写请求语义是否可被系统接收，false 常见于冲突未确认覆盖等可重试场景

items.description_en: The list of conflicting subjects (consumers or consumer groups)
items.description_zh: 冲突的主体（消费者或消费者组）列表

items.description_en: The details of a conflicting subject (consumer or consumer group)
items.description_zh: 冲突的主体（消费者或消费者组）详情

conflictPeriodType.description_en:
The period type of the existing conflicting rule on the consumer subject. Valid values:
day: The existing conflicting rule has a daily period.
week: The existing conflicting rule has a weekly period.
month: The existing conflicting rule has a monthly period
conflictPeriodType.description_zh: 消费主体上已有冲突规则的周期类型。conflictPeriodType  = "day"/"week"/"month"分别表示消费主体已有冲突规则的周期为日/周/月
conflictPeriodType.title_en: 消费者上已有冲突规则的周期类型。conflictPeriodType  = "day"/"week"/"month"分别表示消费者已有冲突规则的周期为日/周/月
conflictPeriodType.title_zh: 消费者上已有冲突规则的周期类型。conflictPeriodType  = "day"/"week"/"month"分别表示消费者已有冲突规则的周期为日/周/月

conflictType.description_en:
The type of the existing conflicting rule on the consumer subject. Valid values:
calendar: The existing conflicting rule uses a calendar period.
epoch: The existing conflicting rule uses a custom period
conflictType.description_zh: 消费主体上已有冲突规则的类型。conflictType  = "calendar"表示消费主体已有冲突规则为自然周期；conflictType = "epoch"表示已有冲突规则为自定义周期
conflictType.title_en: 消费者上已有冲突规则的类型。conflictType  = "calendar"表示消费者已有冲突规则为自然周期；conflictType = "epoch"表示已有冲突规则为自定义周期。
conflictType.title_zh: 消费者上已有冲突规则的类型。conflictType  = "calendar"表示消费者已有冲突规则为自然周期；conflictType = "epoch"表示已有冲突规则为自定义周期。

consumerId.description_en: The conflicting consumer ID. You can use subjectId instead
consumerId.description_zh: 冲突消费者 ID（现可统一使用 subjectId 替代）

consumerName.description_en: The conflicting consumer name. You can use subjectName instead
consumerName.description_zh: 冲突消费者 ID（现可统一使用 subjectName 替代）

subjectId.description_en: The ID of the conflicting subject

subjectName.description_en: The name of the conflicting subject

subjectType.description_en: The type of the conflicting subject. Valid values: consumer and consumer_group
subjectType.description_zh: 冲突主体类型，取值为consumer或consumer_group
subjectType.title_en: 冲突主体类型，取值为consumer或consumer_group。
subjectType.title_zh: 冲突主体类型，取值为consumer或consumer_group。

dryRun.description_en: Indicates whether the request is a dry run

v1_parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the gateway
v1_parameters.name: gatewayId
